purpose: Maintained independent analytical expectations; not authored product request DTOs or observed solver outputs.

numeric_representation.value: Binary64 convenience projection of the independent expectation, never a product observation.
numeric_representation.tolerance: Preserve existing protected relative 1e-9 criteria; use existing dimension-aware zero-reference handling. No new or relaxed threshold is allocated here.

sign_conventions.fit: delta_L_fit<0 is cut short; displayed reference coordinates stay unchanged.
